content:
As a Muslim, I believe in kindness, respect, and uplifting speech. Islam teaches us to avoid harm, mockery, and toxicity. Instead of offensive jokes, let’s foster understanding and compassion—especially in educational spaces.

*"The best among you are those who have the best manners."* (Bukhari) 💙
